content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Naruki 's Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun ( Glasses with a Chance of Delinquent ) manga revealed the main staff, two teaser visuals (pictured above), and teaser promotional video on Tuesday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

title: My Hero Academia Creator’s New Manga Deserves To Be a Longer Series
content: Two years after My Hero Academia reached its conclusion, Kohei Horikoshi returned with a new one-shot manga in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine. The one-shot was released on August 10th, 2026, and caused quite a buzz thanks to the creator’s highly anticipated return.
author: ComicBook

title: Firefly Wedding Anime Reveals Second Teaser Trailer and Additional Cast, October 9 Premiere
content: Firefly Wedding TV anime revealed its second teaser trailer, revealing two additional cast members ahead of its October 9, 2026 premiere. The first promotional video was revealed in March. Kento Ito will voice Kotaro Ogawa, while Kenjiro Tsuda joined the cast as Mitsueda.
author: Anime Corner
